title: Nitin Kumar Nishad v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Arindam Sinha, J.; Satya Veer Singh, J.
disposition: Writ disposed of; petitioner directed to apply under clause 6.5.
headnote: A consumer seeking a writ directing the supply company to raise a correct bill was informed of the clause 6.5 procedure under the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005, directed to apply, and granted leave to enclose a certified copy of the order with that application. The petition was disposed of without examining the bill on merits.
facts: The petitioner, Nitin Kumar Nishad, filed a writ petition in the Allahabad High Court seeking a direction upon the electricity supply company to raise a correct bill. Counsel for the petitioner pressed that prayer. The State appeared through Additional Chief Standing Counsel. Counsel appearing for respondent nos. 2 and 3, the supply company, submitted that the petitioner was required to apply under clause 6.5 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.holding: A writ seeking a direction to the supply company to raise a correct bill is disposed of without merits examination; the consumer must apply under clause 6.5 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and may enclose a certified copy of the order with that application.

not_decided.point: Whether the bill raised by the supply company was incorrect on the merits.
